Write a descriptive, fictional, imaginative screenplay of a mental asylum doctor ordering a schizophrenic patient to take his pills, the patient refuses, and makes him take the pills to prove they are safe. The doctor obliges, but when he opens his eyes, the patient is gone, a figment of his imagination, revealing it was the doctor that was schizophrenic the whole time.  Please use an emoji at the end of every sentence.assistant
response:
INT. MENTAL ASYLUM - DAY 🏥

Dr. Smith, a middle-aged psychiatrist, stands in front of his patient, Jack, a disheveled young man with a wild look in his eye 🤪. 

DR. SMITH: 
"Jack, it's time for your medication. You know the drill 📚." 

JACK: 
"No, I won't take them. They're poison 💉." 

DR. SMITH: 
"Jack, you're not thinking clearly. You need these pills to manage your symptoms 🤯." 

JACK: 
"I don't need them. I'm fine 🙅‍♂️." 

DR. SMITH: 
"Fine? You're not fine, Jack. You're delusional 🤪." 

JACK: 
"I'm not delusional. I'm sane 🙏." 

DR. SMITH: 
"Whatever you say, Jack. Now, take the pills or I'll have to restrain you 🚫." 

JACK: 
"I won't take them. You can't force me 💪." 

DR. SMITH: 
"Fine. I'll take them myself then 💊." 

Dr. Smith picks up the pills and forces them into his own mouth 🤮. 

CUT TO:

INT. MENTAL ASYLUM - LATER 🕰️

Dr. Smith sits in his office, staring blankly at a piece of paper 📝. Suddenly, he looks up and sees Jack standing in front of him 👀. 

DR. SMITH: 
"Jack, what are you doing here? You're not even real 🤔." 

JACK: 
"I'm as real as you are, Doc. You're just the one who's lost his grip 🤪." 

DR. SMITH: 
"What are you talking about? I'm a perfectly sane man 🙄." 

JACK: 
"Oh, really? Then why do you see me? Why do you think I'm real? 🤷‍♂️" 

Dr. Smith's eyes widen in shock 😱. 

DR. SMITH: 
"I...I don't know what you're talking about 🤔." 

JACK: 
"You don't know? That's because you're the one who's been living in a fantasy world all along 🌐." 

Dr. Smith's face contorts in realization 😨. 

DR. SMITH: 
"Jack...you're right. I'm the one who's been delusional all along 🤯." 

JACK: 
"I told you, Doc. I'm as real as you are 🙏." 

The camera zooms out as Dr. Smith's eyes glaze over, and he whispers to himself 🤫. 

DR. SMITH: 
"I'm not sane. I'm not sane at all 🤪."
